description: DiligenceOps: submit a security or vulnerability disclosure policy, or a security.txt file. The signed report marks a contact method, response timelines, scope, safe-harbor language and a PGP key or other secure channel present, missing or ambiguous, with quotes: the reporting contacts, each stated timeline with its stage (acknowledgement, triage, fix or disclosure), the in-scope and out-of-scope hosts, any line that reserves legal action, and for a security.txt file its fields and whether its Expires date has passed. POST /api/security-disclosure-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-disclosure-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the policy, recorded in the report.

policy.description: The security or vulnerability disclosure policy, or a security.txt file, as text or HTML, up to 256 KB.
